text: The planet spins very fast: day and night yield different worlds
description: A sphere planet whose day/night phase switches the world's character (palette, structures, behaviour). Sun phase as a global conditioning input.

status.comment: First version (experiments): `day` fader (seconds per planet day, 0 = fixed sun); day phase in u.step.z; scene.frag circles the sun and blends to a night world (complementary dim colours, warm lit windows on walls, cool moon) by smoothstep of the sun's height; the net takes it on through the colour blend. Builds and runs (14.6 ms/frame). Not verified visually by me. Human step: set day ~60 and color ~0.03 (faster uptake), watch a full cycle: does night read as a different world? Next: the sun phase as a net input (train on day/night footage) so the net itself changes style.
